notes.title: Patch 1.1 is now Live!
notes.notes:
Happy patch day! Again. Haha.

Okay, I know I said last time it would be the patch to go in the physical games. But we fixed up a few more things: namely, the achievement sync (again) and more typo corrections. It's a short list, but the bump in patch number is sort of a way for us to try and separate the builds from pre-physical and post-physical eras.

By the way! If you like the game, please consider leaving us a review. We really love reading everyone's thoughts, and it does help us out quite a bit!


 Another achievement sync update. This should help users sync progress with Steam copies of the game.
 Typos, typos, typos. Also corrected a couple sentences that either had erroneous repetition or odd phrasing.
 The bonus content credits video now contains subtitles.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.31 and 1.0.32
notes.notes:
Hello! We pushed out an update that should fix erroneously granted achievements. Sorry for the trouble!

1.0.31
There's a new file in the game folder that should handle syncing everything up. In case something comes up and you may need additional help, replacing it with a custom fix will be a small matter. As always, feel free to join our Discord or send us an email through melanie@vnstudioelan.com and we'll take care of it.

1.0.32
Fixed an error with the 1.0.31 build to restore the end-game credits.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3 is now Live!
notes.notes:
It's November already! Next week (and some change) will mark the one month anniversary of Twofold's release. Thank you so much everyone for reading, sharing, and talking about these characters and their stories. We're hopeful this will be the last major polish and touch-up pass of the game so we can get the game built into discs and sent off to everyone who pre-ordered the physical edition!

I'll use this space to also say if you create any fanart or media, we'd love if you would either tag us in social media or put it here in the Steam community page! Anyway, onto the notes.


 Mrow.
 An attempt has been made to fix Steam achievements not syncing if you purchased the game elsewhere. If it still doesn't work, we can always send you a fix manually. Fair's fair and we'd want you to collect those shiny cheevos!
 ATL adjustments and fixes, like characters being half-ghost if you click too fast.
 Fixed an error in the History screen where you couldn't scroll up.
 Auto-continue indicator! The CTC now changes to properly show that you have auto mode on, and the Auto button in the quick menu is lit up.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42390322/5de690bf9563c342a886665f0a6d20d3f75c0704.png


 Asset optimization! A couple darker backgrounds have been uncompressed to reduce image artifacting. A diner background variation has also been heavily cropped and optimized to prevent extremely large images from rendering out.
  Lots of tiny fixes to dialogue to match the voice lines. We also standardized punctuation inside of quotes for real this time.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 is now Live!
notes.notes:
First of all, thank you all so much for the warm reception of Twofold. We hope those of you who have yet to finish the story will enjoy what's waiting for you, and those of you who have will keep them in your hearts... leave us a review! It really helps us out. Below are today's patch notes, and underneath that are the notes for the hotfixes released on Day 1.

Patch Notes

 Save/load pages have been adjusted. A proper input caret is used and a character limit applied when renaming pages. Also, scene names that would extend past the border of the save slot will be cut off with "…" at the end.
 Persistent font choice is used in more places throughout the game now, such as the History screen. First time startup also will preview the font in the flavor text of the menu choice
 Gallery expanded with bonus and additional content, such as act cards!
 Credits playback has been fixed. Movies will play only once now rather than looping 1 and a half times!
 Post-Twofold bonus content now contains a splash screen
 Text message scenes that begin with text messages already loaded up will show a tip that remind you to scroll up and down through them
 Various voice mastering issues have been resolved, such as lines cutting out too early and volume adjustments.
 Various music and sound effects have been replaced with their correctly looping/correctly panning versions. No more left-ear exclusive bacon sizzle.
 Tiny improvements and tweaks such as ambience fading in or out of scenes, small typo fixes and grammar corrections, etc.
 Hopefully achievements should only give a notification once they are unlocked! This was causing some confusion with achievements that had progress toggle a popup in Steam, such as Overprepared.

Previous fixes
These changes were already live before 1.0.2.

 Fixed a crash that would occur when accessing post-Twofold content
 A certain achievement not unlocking correctly was fixed

notes.title: Release date, demo and more!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! Elanfest '23 was streamed live today, and with it came a wealth of Twofold news and information! For those who missed the announcements, let's go over everything step-by-step.

First off, here's our latest trailer:

[previewyoutube=JTblKMDIgGs;full][/previewyoutube]

Twofold is releasing this month! We have a couple dates we're aiming for, and will reveal a finalized day a week or two prior to release. We're also hoping to have an OST and artbook ready to go on release as well!

To make the wait a little easier, we're also launching a free demo, available right now! This demo goes over most of the introductory act of the game, and also includes a bonus scene exclusive to the demo that bridges the gap between the post-credits scene of First Snow and the start of Twofold, as told from Hayley's (Caprice and Millie's roommate) point of view.

Our last big surprise of the day comes in the form of a physical release! Starting today, you can pre-order a copy of Twofold: The Perfect Circle Collection, which includes Twofold as well as First Snow! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42390322/55546c149db579ed88dfe9352ac71b6bfecb06e1.png

This physical edition of the game will also include a First Snow-themed reversible cover, so you can choose which game you want to sit on your shelf. Please be aware that this will not be a simultaneous release with the digital version. Pre-order your copy here.

That's it for today's announcements! We hope everyone is eager to join a club later this month!
